description: Non-stock factory springs (within the same series) (15  points)

description: Aftermarket springs or factory springs from a different model series. (30 points)

description: Non-stock non-adjustable sway bar(s) (10 points)

description: Non-stock adjustable sway bar(s) (20 points)

description: Suspension changes to lower a car that require machining, welding, etc. or their equivalent. (10 points)

description: Installation of “Monoball” suspension bushings or equivalent 10 (points)

description: Tube frame chassis (100 points)

description: Non-stock aero devices that came from another car within the same model series. (10 points)

label: Oem Aero
description: Non-stock aero devices that came from another car not within the same model series. (20 points)

label: Aftermarket Aero
description: Any aftermarket aero devices. (40 points)

description: Removal or alteration of windshield (other than replacement with lighter weight materials) (60 points)

description: Brake Upgrades (other than drilled/gas slotted stock rotors, brake pads, master cylinder, or aftermarket rotors with no increase in diameter). Includes factory or post-delivery installation of ceramic brakes (20 points)
